Comment.Language: For the Entrance of the Holy Family into Egypt on the Feast of the Pentecost:

Text.Language: V/e~taftwnf ouoh afsenaf afouwrp m~piparakl/ton pip~neuma n~te ]meym/i. afi~ e~qoun e~t,wra n~,/mi: Cw] m~mon ouoh nai nan.
who rose from the dead and ascended into the Heavens and sent to us the spirit of truth, the Paraclete, entered into the land of Egypt. Save us and have mercy on us.
الذي قام ثم صعد وأرسل البارقليط روح الحق, دخل الي كورة مصر. خَلِّصْنا وارحَمْنا.
